concerns.text: Task T008 (generation) consumes the model loaded by T005, but the dependency table lists only T006 as a prerequisite. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

Task T010 (aggregate) concatenates cleaned batch files produced by T009, yet the dependency table lists only T008 as a prerequisite. The aggregation step must depend on T009 to ensure the cleaned files exist before concatenation.
